about: Hand-written rotation guides for the mage's player pages (guides.py). Rewritten 2026-11-04 on the 2026-11-02 patch data (client 70753): the lists the pages show that day, the full-raid casts and damage shares of the simulator's environments runs, and the fight lab's 2026-11-04 signature audit (300 fights a level).

raid.plan: Frost in a raid is one spell and one proc: **Frostbolt** on every cast and a free, fast **Arcane Missiles** whenever **Missile Barrage** lights up, with **Presence of Mind** at the pull and one **Fire Blast** in the last 3 seconds. It is the weakest mage page in the simulator (526 DPS in a full raid against Fire's 869): the search's best Frost build, 612, fails the spec's signature rule and sits under Other builds.
why: **Frostbolt** is the list: 62 casts and 76% of the damage in a 3-minute raid fight. It casts in 2.5 seconds with **Improved Frostbolt**, costs 260 mana at the rank the list names (rank 10) less **Frost Channeling**'s 15%, crits for double with **Ice Shards**, and every one that lands has a 20% chance (**Missile Barrage**) to make your next **Arcane Missiles** free, half as long and twice as dense.

**Arcane Missiles** on a **Missile Barrage** proc comes first: about 10 casts and 23% of the damage, each a 2.5-second channel that costs nothing, with **Arcane Impact**'s 6% crit. **Improved Channeling** at 4 points gives an 80% chance that a hit does not cut it short. The list names rank 7, as the simulator's rotation has since October; a free cast costs the same at any rank.

**Fire Blast** only in the last 3 seconds (about one a fight): a **Frostbolt** started then is still in the air when the boss dies, while **Fire Blast** is instant. Earlier in the fight the search kept it out: it rolls for no proc, costs 340 mana against the **Frostbolt**'s 260, and no talent of this build improves it.
**Presence of Mind** at the pull makes one **Frostbolt** instant; its cooldown is 3 minutes, so a 3-minute fight gets one.

Mana is not a problem with a raid's buffs: the full list uses your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) below 80% mana and **Evocation** below 20% with more than 25 seconds left; the simulator used the gem in about one fight in six and never channeled **Evocation**. **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free and **Arcane Meditation** keeps a third of your regeneration going while you cast.

**Winter's Chill**, the build's name, no longer helps this list: since the 2026-11-02 patch its stacks only make your next **Cone of Cold** hit harder (20% more damage and 7% of your spell damage per stack, up to 5), and no single-target list casts **Cone of Cold** on a boss. **Frostbite** does nothing on a boss either: bosses cannot be frozen. The build is a hand draft from before the change and stays until a Frost build that passes the signature rule is found.
caveats: The 612-DPS Frost build under Other builds (from the machine-learning search) takes Arcane Blast, Ice Lance, Shatter and Fingers of Frost in place of Winter's Chill, Ice Block, Presence of Mind and Arcane Meditation, and plays a longer list: two stacks of the Arcane Blast buff kept up and Ice Lance on a Fingers of Frost proc. It fails the signature check because Frost's own spells carry 53% of its damage, under the 60% the rule asks for (Arcane Blast and **Arcane Missiles** carry the rest). If the rule does not matter to you, it is 16% more damage.

Several targets: **Blizzard**, **Cone of Cold** (five **Frostbolt** hits first: five **Winter's Chill** stacks double its damage and add 35% of your spell damage) and **Arcane Explosion**. The simulator's fights are one boss.
Moving: **Fire Blast** is this build's only instant ranged attack (it takes no Ice Lance), and **Presence of Mind** makes one **Frostbolt** instant.
Threat: **Frost Channeling** and **Arcane Subtlety** cut your Frost and Arcane threat by 30%; the simulator ignores threat, so give the tank a few seconds on a fresh pull.
diverge: In the last 3 seconds, **Fire Blast** instead of a **Frostbolt**.
Without a paladin's or shaman's mana buffs, the simulator's list for playing alone channels **Evocation** only below 5% mana and with more than 50 seconds left, not at the raid list's 20%.
On a pack, five **Frostbolt** hits and then **Cone of Cold** use the **Winter's Chill** stacks this list otherwise wastes.

leveling.plan: Frost levels by slowing, freezing and shattering: **Frostbolt** slows the mob as it walks in, **Frost Nova** freezes it when it arrives, you step back, and **Ice Lance** hits the frozen target for four times its damage with **Shatter**'s crit chance. Frost points first (**Ice Lance** at 20, **Shatter** complete by 29, **Fingers of Frost** at 30-31, the rest of the Frost tree to 39), then the Arcane mana talents from 40 (**Arcane Concentration** by 49, **Arcane Meditation** by 57), **Incineration** last (58-60). In the open leveling search's 20-60 race of 2026-11-06 this build took about 30.5 seconds per kill, level-weighted; the page's numbers table has each level.
why: **Frostbolt** from as far away as you can and whenever nothing else applies, while the mob has more than a fifth of its health: 2.5 seconds with **Improved Frostbolt** at 5 points, 290 mana at top rank less **Frost Channeling**'s 15%, and a 40% slow for 9 seconds that buys extra casts before the mob reaches you (**Permafrost** lengthens it). Every chill can freeze the mob (**Frostbite**, 15%) or light up **Fingers of Frost** (15%: your next 2 spells count as cast on a frozen target). If the mob would reach you before the cast ends and **Frost Nova** is ready, wand it until it arrives; if it is already on you with **Frost Nova** down, keep casting.

**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of melee: it freezes the mob for up to 8 seconds (damage can break it), and out of reach it cannot hit you or push your casts back. **Improved Frost Nova** takes 4 seconds off its 25-second cooldown.

**Ice Lance** into the freeze whenever it is ready: it deals 300% more damage to a frozen target, crits 50% more often there with **Shatter**, and crits for double with **Ice Shards**. It has an 8-second cooldown, so you get one per freeze, not a stream. In the open search's talent values at level 60, the build loses about 4.6 seconds per kill without **Shatter**, 3.5 without **Ice Lance**, 2.4 without **Ice Shards** and 2.0 without **Improved Frostbolt**.

**Fire Blast** is the finish and nothing else: the tuned rules (2026-11-06) cast it only while the mob is between a tenth and a fifth of its health, and start no **Frostbolt** below a fifth. A long cast overkills, and an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand, finishes cheaper. It is not the answer to a mob that reaches you. **Incineration** adds crit to **Fire Blast** and **Ice Lance**.

The Arcane points are for mana: **Arcane Concentration** gives a 10% chance after a damage spell hits that your next one is free, and **Arcane Meditation** (which needs all 5 **Arcane Concentration** points) keeps half your regeneration going while you cast (about 1.4 seconds per kill at 60 in the open search). **Wand Specialization** makes the finishing wand hits 25% stronger.
**Counterspell** (level 24) a mob that casts spells: it stops the cast and locks that school for 10 seconds.
caveats: This build takes neither Cold Snap nor Ice Barrier: skip the list's lines for them. The hand-made build under Other builds has both.
This is the open leveling search's 18/3/30 winner: **Improved Frostbolt** at 5 points and **Improved Channeling** instead of an earlier version's Missile Barrage and Magic Absorption.
**Cone of Cold** stays out of single pulls: the tuned rules switch it off (kills measured faster without).

Drink below 15% of your mana (the tuned rule); **Evocation** between fights, whenever it is ready and you are under 40% mana; eat below two thirds of your health (the tuned rules set no eat threshold for this list, so the fight lab's default of 65% applies).
**Frost Armor** and **Ice Armor** can chill a mob that hits you, another roll for **Frostbite** to freeze it.
Pulls of several mobs are a different game: the AoE build under Other builds gathers about four, freezes them with **Frost Nova** and uses **Blizzard** and **Cone of Cold**.
diverge: If **Frost Nova** is on cooldown when the mob arrives, keep casting **Frostbolt**; a build with Cold Snap resets **Frost Nova** instead when it has more than 8 seconds left and the mob still has 40% of its health.
Low on mana in a fight: let an **Ice Lance** into the freeze or the wand finish a nearly dead mob rather than start a **Frostbolt**.

raid.plan: Arcane-Frost is an Arcane list with a **Frostbolt** filler: keep two stacks of your **Arcane Blast** buff up, **Arcane Wrath** whenever it is ready, a free **Arcane Missiles** on every **Missile Barrage** proc, and **Frostbolt** in every gap, which rolls for the proc too. There is no cooldown to press: the build takes neither Presence of Mind nor Arcane Power. 693 DPS in a full raid, 12% behind the Arcane page.
why: **Arcane Missiles** on **Missile Barrage** comes first: 14 casts and 30% of the damage. **Arcane Blast** gives a 40% chance per cast, **Arcane Wrath** and **Frostbolt** 20% each, so with three sources the proc is up often; it makes the next Missiles free, 2.5 seconds long and twice as dense. **Arcane Impact** adds 6% crit, **Arcane Mind** doubles the crit bonus of your Arcane spells, and **Arcane Instability** adds 3% damage and 3% crit to everything.

**Arcane Blast**, 25 casts and 16%: keep its buff stacked on you. Each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds, stacking to 4, and adds 100% to its mana cost per stack; the list casts it when the buff is missing or about to run out and until it has 2 stacks, then lets **Frostbolt** fill. Adding that line was the raid search's biggest gain for this entry (+6.1%).

**Arcane Wrath** whenever it is ready (13 casts, 24%): 3 seconds with **Accelerant**, a 6-second cooldown, 406-496 damage plus 5% of your maximum mana as spell damage, and its own **Missile Barrage** roll. The list stops it with 20 seconds left: late casts and their flight time overrun the fight (+0.4% in the search).

**Frostbolt** fills everything else (27 casts, 30%): 2.5 seconds with **Improved Frostbolt**, 260 mana at the rank the list names (rank 10), **Precision**'s 6% hit, **Ice Shards**' doubled crit bonus, and a 20% **Missile Barrage** roll of its own. The Frost half ends at **Ice Shards**: this build has no Ice Lance, Shatter or Fingers of Frost.
**Fire Blast** only in the last 3 seconds, when a **Frostbolt** would land too late; **Incineration** gives it 10% crit.

Mana: your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) below 80% mana, a mana potion, **Arcane Concentration** at 5 points (10% free casts) and **Magic Absorption** (1% of your mana back for each spell you fully resist). With a raid's buffs the simulator almost never needed **Evocation** here (one fight in 750); its line fires below 20% mana with more than 25 seconds left.
caveats: The Arcane page's build is the same idea with Arcane's cooldowns and a Fire filler: it takes Presence of Mind, Arcane Power, Pyroblast and Heating Up, casts **Fire Blast** on cooldown and fills with **Fireball**: 790 against 693. This page exists because the hybrid split is its own spec on these pages.
Several targets: **Arcane Explosion**, **Blizzard** and **Cone of Cold**; the simulator fights one boss.
Moving: **Fire Blast** is your only instant. Threat: **Arcane Subtlety** cuts Arcane threat by 30%; the simulator ignores threat.
diverge: In the last 20 seconds no **Arcane Wrath**; in the last 3 seconds **Fire Blast** instead of a **Frostbolt**.
Without raid mana buffs, the simulator's list for playing alone channels **Evocation** only below 5% mana while more than 50 seconds remain; later, the mana comes back too late to spend.

leveling.plan: This hybrid plays the Frost list with one Arcane addition: **Frostbolt** at range, **Frost Nova** and a step back when the mob arrives, **Ice Lance** into the freeze, and a free, fast **Arcane Missiles** whenever **Missile Barrage** lights up. Its Frost points come first (**Ice Lance** at 20, **Shatter** complete by 29, **Fingers of Frost** at 30-31), then Arcane from 32 (**Wand Specialization**, **Arcane Resilience**, **Improved Channeling**, **Missile Barrage** complete at 38, **Arcane Concentration** by 44, **Arcane Meditation** by 50, **Presence of Mind** at 53), then **Improved Frost Nova**, **Permafrost** and **Winter's Chill**, and **Arcane Mind** at 59-60. In the open leveling search's 20-60 race of 2026-11-06 it was the fastest mage leveling build, about 29.1 seconds per kill level-weighted against 30.5 for the Frost page's build and 31.2 for the Arcane page's; the page's numbers table has each level.
why: **Frostbolt** from as far away as you can and as the filler while the mob has more than a fifth of its health: its slow buys casts before the mob arrives, its chill rolls **Frostbite** (15% to freeze) and **Fingers of Frost** (15%: the next 2 spells count as cast on a frozen target), and with **Missile Barrage** each one has a 20% chance to light up a free **Arcane Missiles**. If the mob would reach you before the cast ends and **Frost Nova** is ready, wand it until it arrives; if it is on you with **Frost Nova** down, keep casting.

**Arcane Missiles** only on a **Missile Barrage** proc: half the channel (2.5 seconds), no mana, missiles every half second. Cast it at range or into a freeze, not while the mob is hitting you unless it is frozen: hits can cut the channel short until **Improved Channeling** has all 5 points (taken by level 52), when a hit never does. Without **Missile Barrage** a kill takes about 2.3 seconds longer at 60 in the open search.

**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you, then step back; **Ice Lance** while it is frozen: 300% more damage to a frozen target, 50% more crit chance from **Shatter** and bigger crits from **Ice Shards**. **Ice Lance** has an 8-second cooldown, one per freeze. At 60 the build loses about 4.0 seconds per kill without **Shatter**, 2.7 without **Ice Lance**, 2.0 without **Ice Shards** and 1.2 without **Fingers of Frost** (open search, 2026-11-06).

**Fire Blast** is the finish and nothing else: the tuned rules (2026-11-06) cast it only while the mob is between a tenth and a fifth of its health, and start no **Frostbolt** below a fifth. Below a tenth an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand, finishes it. It is not the answer to a mob that reaches you.

The rest of the Arcane half is mana: **Arcane Concentration** gives a 10% chance after a damage spell hits that your next one is free, and **Arcane Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast; **Wand Specialization** makes the finishing wand hits 25% stronger. **Presence of Mind** (level 53) makes one cast instant every 3 minutes: the fight lab opens a pull with an instant **Frostbolt**. The two **Arcane Mind** points at 59-60 add 4% Intellect. The tuned rules drink only below 15% of your mana and eat below 40% of your health, later than the Frost page's list eats.
caveats: This build takes no Cold Snap: skip that part of the list. Before the Arcane half it is a plain Frost mage without **Missile Barrage**.
**Cone of Cold** stays out of single pulls: the tuned rules switch it off, so the single **Winter's Chill** point (level 58) does nothing on one mob.
Rest: drink below 15% of your mana, **Evocation** between fights when it is ready and you are under 40% mana, eat below 40% of your health.

This is the open leveling search's 23/0/28 winner (2026-11-04): **Presence of Mind** and two points of **Arcane Mind** instead of Arcane Blast and the Fire points (Incineration) of the earlier 18/2/31 build. Arcane Blast is not in this build: skip any line for it.
diverge: On a nearly dead mob, skip even a free **Arcane Missiles**: an **Ice Lance** or **Fire Blast** that will kill, or the wand.
Mob on you with **Frost Nova** down: keep casting **Frostbolt**; the list does not use **Fire Blast** or **Cone of Cold** here.

raid.plan: Arcane in a raid keeps its own **Arcane Blast** buff stacked (each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds, up to 4 stacks, at a doubling mana cost), fires **Arcane Wrath** every 6 seconds and **Fire Blast** every 7, spends every **Missile Barrage** proc on a free, fast **Arcane Missiles**, and casts **Pyroblast** once three crits have made it a 1.5-second cast. It is the hungriest mage list: even with a raid's mana buffs the simulator needs **Evocation** in 9 fights of 10. 756 DPS in a full raid.
why: **Arcane Missiles** on **Missile Barrage** first (about 15 casts, 29%): **Arcane Blast** procs it 40% of the time, **Arcane Wrath** 20%; the proc makes the next Missiles free, 2.5 seconds long and twice as dense. **Arcane Impact** adds 6% crit, **Arcane Mind** 10% Intellect and a doubled Arcane crit bonus, **Arcane Instability** 3% damage and crit. The list names rank 7, as the simulator's rotation does; a free cast costs the same at any rank.

**Arcane Wrath** whenever it is ready (17 casts, 28%): 3 seconds with **Accelerant**, a 6-second cooldown, 406-496 damage plus 5% of your maximum mana as spell damage, and a proc roll. Moving it to the top of the list was the search's biggest single gain (+8.9%). Not in the last 10 seconds.

**Arcane Blast** (37 casts, 22%): keep its buff stacked on you. Cast it when the buff is gone or about to expire and until it has 3 stacks (the full list's conditions), then only while you have more than 25% mana, because the cost doubles with every stack. 1.5 seconds a cast, 10% crit from **Incineration**, and each one rolls 40% for a **Missile Barrage**.
**Fire Blast** on cooldown (14 casts, 10%): instant, every 7 seconds with one point of **Improved Fire Blast**, 10% crit from **Incineration**, and every hit adds a **Heating Up** stack.

**Pyroblast** at 3 stacks of **Heating Up** (4 casts, 7%, plus **Ignite**'s 2%): crits from **Fire Blast** and **Fireball** cut its 6-second cast by 25% each, and **Fire Blast** adds a stack on every hit, so three stacks come about every 45 seconds and the cast takes 1.5 seconds. Never hard-cast it otherwise.
**Arcane Power** and **Presence of Mind** at the pull: 30% more damage for 15 seconds at 30% more mana, and one instant **Arcane Wrath**; both have 3-minute cooldowns.

Mana: **Evocation** when nearly dry (0.9 casts a fight in the simulator), a mana potion about every 2 minutes, your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) and a Demonic Rune; **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free, **Arcane Meditation** at 2 points keeps a third of your regeneration going. When nothing above is affordable, **Fireball** rank 11 fills, about once a fight.
caveats: A 6-minute fight is a different list: the simulator's DPS falls from 756 at 3 minutes to 412 at 6, because the mana runs out. Longer fights want fewer **Arcane Blast** stacks and an earlier **Evocation**.
Moving: **Arcane Blast**, **Arcane Wrath** and **Arcane Missiles** all need you to stand. **Fire Blast** is your instant, and **Presence of Mind** makes one cast instant.
Threat: **Arcane Subtlety** cuts Arcane threat by 30%, but the simulator ignores threat, and **Arcane Power** at the pull is when you are most likely to pull the boss.
Several targets: **Arcane Explosion** hits everything within 10 yards; **Flamestrike** and **Blizzard** are the rest.
diverge: In the last 10 seconds no **Arcane Wrath**, in the last 3 no **Arcane Blast**: **Fire Blast**, and a free **Arcane Missiles** if you have one.

Without a raid's mana buffs the simulator's list for playing alone spends two **Arcane Blast** stacks on a **Frostbolt** instead of a fourth cast and casts **Fire Blast** only on cooldown: cheaper and slower.
In a fight longer than 3 minutes, use **Arcane Power** and **Presence of Mind** again when they are back, and channel **Evocation** below 15% mana while more than 20 seconds remain.

leveling.plan: Arcane levels on its own spells: **Arcane Wrath** to open (from 25), two **Arcane Blast** stacks while the mob walks in, then **Arcane Missiles**, which you keep channeling when the mob reaches you; **Frost Nova** and a step back when it arrives. The page's order takes Arcane first (**Arcane Blast** at 20, **Missile Barrage** at 21-22, **Presence of Mind** at 30) and Frost from level 40, all but **Arcane Power** at 59. In the open leveling search's 20-60 race of 2026-11-06 it took about 31.2 seconds per kill level-weighted, behind the Arcane-Frost and Frost pages' builds; the page's numbers table has each level.
why: **Presence of Mind** (level 30) at the pull makes your first cast instant (the opening **Arcane Wrath** in the fight lab). From level 59 **Arcane Power** goes at the pull too, whenever it is ready and you have more than half your mana: 15 seconds of 30% more spell damage at 30% more mana cost.

**Arcane Wrath** opens when its cast (3.5 seconds) lands before the mob arrives, then goes out whenever it is ready (6-second cooldown) and the cast fits. It gains spell damage equal to 5% of your maximum mana, and each cast has a 20% chance to light up **Missile Barrage**.

**Arcane Blast** twice while the mob walks in: each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds and doubles the next cast's cost, so the fight lab stops at two and starts one only while it costs at most a quarter of your mana and will finish before the mob reaches you. Each cast rolls 40% for **Missile Barrage**. Without **Arcane Blast** a kill at 60 takes about 1.9 seconds longer in the open search.

**Arcane Missiles** is the main spell, at range and in melee: **Improved Channeling** at 5 points gives a 100% chance that hits do not interrupt the channel (70% for **Arcane Blast** and **Arcane Wrath**). **Missile Barrage** makes the next one free, 2.5 seconds long and twice as dense: cast it at once after your two stacks, or when the mob is on you. At level 60 the build loses about 4.6 seconds per kill without **Missile Barrage**, 1.9 without **Improved Channeling**, then **Arcane Mind** (1.6), **Arcane Meditation** (1.5), **Arcane Instability** (1.4) and **Arcane Concentration** (1.3).

**Frost Nova** is in the list: when the mob reaches you and has more than about a tenth of its health, freeze it and step back, then keep channeling. The tuned rules (2026-11-06) switch off only **Cone of Cold**, which is cast just when the mob is on you and below a fifth of its health.

**Fire Blast** finishes a mob it will kill, and when you cannot afford **Arcane Missiles** it is the instant for a mob on you, else **Frostbolt**. The 20 Frost points come last, from level 40: **Precision** for hit, **Improved Frostbolt**, **Ice Shards**, **Improved Frost Nova**, **Frost Warding**, **Ice Lance** at 50, then **Improved Blizzard**, **Shatter** (55-56, 60) and **Permafrost** (57-58). A freeze comes from **Frost Nova** or a chill (your armor chilling a mob that hits you); **Ice Lance** into it was worth about 1.1 seconds per kill at 60 in the open search, before the filler pass added **Shatter**'s 50% crit chance against a frozen mob.
caveats: This build takes **Ice Lance** only at level 50: before that, skip its line of the list.

Mana: **Arcane Missiles** costs 655 at top rank, every **Arcane Blast** stack makes the next one dearer. **Frostbolt** (290) is for when you cannot afford the Missiles. The tuned rules set no thresholds for this list, so the fight lab rests at its defaults: drink below 35% of your mana (about a third), eat below 65% of your health (two thirds); use **Evocation** between fights when it is ready and you are under 40% mana.
Single pulls only: with several mobs on you, **Frost Nova** and **Arcane Explosion** are back in play.

This is the open leveling search's 30/0/21 winner (Frost as the second tree), written in place of an earlier 31/17/3 build with Fire points and Arcane Power; the search's race had the two within 0.1% at levels 20-60, a tie. The leveling filler pass of 2026-11-09 moved five points that measured nothing or only held a tier open (both Arctic Reach, Fingers of Frost and one point each of **Permafrost** and **Improved Blizzard**) to **Shatter**, **Arcane Power** and **Improved Frost Nova**: 31/0/20.
diverge: If the mob would reach you before an **Arcane Blast** or **Arcane Wrath** finishes, do not start it: channel **Arcane Missiles** instead (an instant cast with **Presence of Mind** is the exception).
A mob that hits harder than a normal same-level mob is worth a **Frost Nova** even when it is nearly dead: the rule that skips it only reflects the mobs the fight lab models.
Against a caster mob, **Counterspell** it when it starts a cast, as every mage list in the fight lab does.

raid.plan: Fire keeps its own **Improved Scorch** debuff at 5 stacks, fires **Fire Blast** every 6 seconds, casts **Pyroblast** whenever three crits have made it a 1.5-second cast, keeps one stack of its **Arcane Blast** buff up, spends **Missile Barrage** procs on free **Arcane Missiles**, and fills with **Fireball** or **Scorch**. The best mage page in the simulator: 869 DPS in a full raid.
why: **Pyroblast** at 3 stacks of **Heating Up** is the first spell on the list (14 casts, 25%; its crits also feed **Ignite**, 10%): crits from **Fireball**, **Fire Blast** and **Scorch** each cut its 6-second cast by 25%, and **Fire Blast** adds a stack on every hit, so three stacks come about every 13 seconds and the cast takes 1.5 seconds. One hard cast before the pull lands as the fight starts.

**Fire Blast** on cooldown (29 casts, 21%): every 6 seconds with **Improved Fire Blast**, instant, 10% crit from **Incineration** and 6% from **Critical Mass**; its crits start **Ignite** (40% of the hit over 4 seconds) and every hit feeds **Heating Up**.

**Scorch** keeps Fire Vulnerability at 5 stacks (**Improved Scorch**: 3% more Fire damage per stack for 30 seconds) and refreshes it under 5 seconds left. It is also the short filler (23 casts in all, 11%): when **Fire Blast** will be back before a 3-second **Fireball** could land, the list casts a 1.5-second **Scorch** instead.

**Fire Power** is why the burns matter: 3% more Fire damage per Fire effect of yours on the target, up to 12%, and Fire Vulnerability, **Ignite**, **Pyroblast**'s burn and **Fireball**'s burn are four. **Fireball** (18 casts, 20%) casts in 3 seconds with all five points of **Accelerant**; the list names rank 11 (rank 12 comes from a tome).

The 17 Arcane points: one **Arcane Blast** about every 20 seconds (9 casts, 4%) keeps its buff on you (12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds) and rolls 40% for **Missile Barrage**, which **Fireball** rolls at 20%; the proc's free, fast **Arcane Missiles** are 9% of the damage (6 casts). **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free.

**Combustion** once Fire Vulnerability has 5 stacks (the list holds every cooldown until then; one a fight on its 3-minute cooldown): each Fire hit adds 10% Fire crit until you land 3 crits, which fills **Heating Up** fast.

Mana: a mana potion whenever it is ready (2 a fight, the list's top line), your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) and a Demonic Rune (about one each), and **Master of Elements**' 20% refund on every Fire crit. The raid list no longer channels **Evocation**: the search dropped that line on 2026-11-10 (+0.4%). Without a raid's mana buffs the simulator's DPS falls 23% from a 3-minute to a 6-minute fight: the mana runs out.
caveats: Mana without a raid's buffs: the simulator's list for playing alone adds **Evocation** below 10% mana with more than 25 seconds left.
Several targets: **Flamestrike** (this build has no Blast Wave); **Fire Blast** hits one target only.
Fire resistance: the simulator's boss resists nothing. Against a target that resists Fire, **Frostbolt** is your fallback and most of this list loses value.
Threat: this build skips Burning Soul, so only **Arcane Subtlety** lowers your threat, and only for the Arcane spells; the simulator ignores threat.
diverge: In the last 3 seconds a **Fireball** would land too late: **Scorch** or **Fire Blast**.
Moving: **Fire Blast** and the 1.5-second **Scorch** keep the stacks and **Heating Up** going; **Pyroblast** and **Fireball** wait.

The list has no 2-stack **Pyroblast** line (the simulator's own Fire rotation, which this list is built on, dropped it): with 2 stacks and the boss about to die, a **Scorch** and a **Fire Blast** in the same 3 seconds are its choice.

leveling.plan: Fire levels with **Fireball** at range and **Fire Blast** up close, opens every pull from level 20 with a hard-cast **Pyroblast**, and borrows the Frost tree's freeze: **Frost Nova**, a step back, and **Ice Lance** into the frozen mob; **Heating Up** (level 44) makes some later **Pyroblast** casts fast. The page's order is **Accelerant** and **Ignite** to 19, **Pyroblast** at 20, 18 Frost points and one Arcane point (**Wand Specialization** at 35) from 21 to 39 (**Ice Lance** at 31, **Shatter** by 39), then Fire again from 40 (**Improved Fire Blast**, **Burning Soul**, **Heating Up**, **Incineration**, **Critical Mass**, **Fire Power**, **Master of Elements**, **Combustion** at 59). In the open leveling search's 20-60 race of 2026-11-06 it took about 38 seconds per kill level-weighted, the slowest of the five mage leveling pages; the page's numbers table has each level.
why: The 18 Frost points: **Precision** (hit), **Frost Warding**, **Improved Frost Nova** (**Frost Nova** back 4 seconds sooner), **Frostbite**, **Ice Shards**, **Ice Lance** and **Shatter**. A frozen mob takes 300% more damage from **Ice Lance**, which crits 50% more often there with **Shatter** and for double with **Ice Shards**; **Ice Lance** has an 8-second cooldown, one per freeze. In the open search the build loses about 3.5 seconds per kill at 60 without **Ice Lance** and 3.2 without **Shatter**.

**Fireball** from as far away as you can, and as the filler whenever nothing else applies, while the mob has more than about a third (35%) of its health. Below that the tuned rules (2026-11-06) start no **Fireball** or **Pyroblast**: a long cast overkills. **Accelerant** takes half a second off its cast at 5 points.

**Pyroblast** opens every pull (a tuned rule that makes the Fire signature spell part of every fight): a 6-second cast the mob runs in during, so finish it and go on. After that it is cast only at 3 stacks of **Heating Up**, while the mob has more than a third of its health.

**Fire Blast** is your instant: when the mob would reach you before a **Fireball** lands, when it is on you and **Frost Nova** is down, and to finish a mob it will kill. **Improved Fire Blast** (level 40-41) takes 2 seconds off its 8-second cooldown, **Critical Mass** and **Incineration** (10% on **Fire Blast** and **Ice Lance** at 5 points) add crit, and every hit adds a **Heating Up** stack.

**Heating Up**: crits with **Fireball**, **Fire Blast** and **Scorch**, and every **Fire Blast** hit, each cut your next **Pyroblast**'s cast by 25%, up to 3 stacks. At 3 stacks its 6-second cast takes 1.5 seconds. On one mob the 3 stacks rarely come together before it dies, so the opener stays the main **Pyroblast**.

**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you, only while you have 30% of your mana or more, then step back; **Ice Lance** while it is frozen; with **Frost Nova** down, **Fire Blast** and keep casting. The tuned rules never cast **Scorch**, so the page's **Improved Scorch** point does nothing in this list.

**Ignite** (40% of every crit's damage over 4 seconds), **Master of Elements** (30% of the base cost back on every Fire or Frost crit) and **Fire Power** (up to 12% more Fire damage with several Fire effects on the mob) are the Fire tree's passive half. **Combustion** goes at the pull once you have it at level 59.
caveats: This build has no Ice Block: a pull that goes wrong is **Blink**, **Mana Shield** or a healing potion.

Mana: **Fireball** costs 410 at top rank against 290 for a **Frostbolt**. Drink below 15% of your mana and eat below 40% of your health (the tuned rules); use **Evocation** between fights when it is ready and you are under 40% mana.
Pulls of several mobs: **Flamestrike** hits them all, but the fight lab only measured single pulls for Fire.

This is the open leveling search's 0/32/19 winner, a tie (0.1%) with the hand-made build it replaced. The search's 0/31/20 alternative never casts **Pyroblast** at level 40 in the fight lab and fails the Fire signature rule, so it was not used. The leveling filler pass of 2026-11-09 moved eight points that measured nothing or only held a tier open (Ice Block, Permafrost, Blast Wave, Impact, two of **Improved Scorch** and one each of **Ice Shards** and **Burning Soul**) to **Incineration**, **Improved Frost Nova** and **Wand Specialization**: 1/32/18.
diverge: On a nearly dead mob (below about a third), finish with an instant that will kill (**Fire Blast**, an **Ice Lance** into a freeze) or the wand rather than start a **Fireball**.
If you run low on mana in a fight, keep **Fire Blast** and **Ice Lance** for the freeze and let the wand finish.

raid.plan: Frostfire is a Fire list whose main spell is **Frostfire Bolt**: it counts as both Fire and Frost, so both trees' talents apply, its chill rolls **Fingers of Frost**, and its crits stack **Heating Up** for a 1.5-second **Pyroblast**. **Scorch** keeps Fire Vulnerability at 5 stacks and **Fire Blast** fills between casts. **Ice Lance** is in the build only because **Fingers of Frost** requires it: the list never casts it. 759 DPS in a full raid, 8% behind the Fire page.
why: **Scorch** keeps Fire Vulnerability at 5 stacks (**Improved Scorch**: 3% more Fire damage per stack for 30 seconds, and **Frostfire Bolt** counts as Fire) and refreshes it under 10 seconds left, a wider margin than the Fire list's 5 (+2.2% in the search), between casts unless the stacks are under 4. About 14 casts and 7% of the damage. Trinkets and the other cooldowns wait for the fifth stack.

**Pyroblast** at 3 stacks of **Heating Up** (12 casts, 22%, and most of **Ignite**'s 13%): crits from **Frostfire Bolt**, **Fire Blast** and **Scorch** cut its cast by 25% each and **Fire Blast** adds a stack on every hit. One hard cast before the pull.

**Fire Blast** (21 casts, 17%) every 6 seconds with **Improved Fire Blast**, but only while fewer than 2 **Fingers of Frost** charges are up. A proc treats your next 2 spells as cast on a frozen target, where **Shatter** adds 50% crit chance: the list spends both charges on **Frostfire Bolt**, whose crit starts **Ignite** and a **Heating Up** stack, and holds **Fire Blast** until a charge is gone.

**Frostfire Bolt** fills everything else (40 casts, 41%): 2.5 seconds with **Accelerant**, 370 mana less **Frost Channeling**'s 15%, a 40% slow, **Ice Shards**' doubled crit bonus and **Critical Mass**'s 6% crit, and one cast rolls for **Fingers of Frost**, **Heating Up**, **Ignite** and **Master of Elements**' refund at once. It is checked against the lower of the target's Fire and Frost resistance.

**Ice Lance** has no line: on the same **Fingers of Frost** charge a **Frostfire Bolt** is worth more than its 136-160 damage, and the search dropped the **Ice Lance** line in its last passes. The talent is the one point **Fingers of Frost** requires.

**Fire Power** adds 3% Fire damage per Fire effect of yours on the target, up to 12%: Fire Vulnerability, **Ignite** and **Pyroblast**'s burn count; **Frostfire Bolt**'s own burn, a mixed school, does not.

Mana: your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Citrine**) whenever it is ready, two mana potions, a Demonic Rune, **Master of Elements**, and **Evocation** once a fight (an 8-minute cooldown). In a 6-minute fight the simulator's DPS falls to 306: this list is the mage's most front-loaded.
caveats: **Fingers of Frost** charges go to the next 2 spells you cast, whatever they are: do not spend one on a **Scorch** refresh if a **Frostfire Bolt** fits.
Moving: **Fire Blast** and the 1.5-second **Scorch**. For packs, **Flamestrike** and **Blizzard**.
**Frostfire Bolt** is new in Forever: its numbers are the simulator's model of the tooltip, not checked in game.
The simulator's boss resists nothing. Against Fire resistance **Frostfire Bolt** keeps working (the lower of the two resistances), while **Fire Blast**, **Scorch** and **Pyroblast** lose damage.
diverge: In the last 3 seconds, **Scorch** instead of starting a **Frostfire Bolt**.
Out of mana with the fight going on: **Evocation** if it is back, else **Scorch** (150 mana) keeps the stacks and **Heating Up** moving until a gem or potion returns.

leveling.plan: The Frostfire leveling build is a Frost mage whose bolt changes at level 40: **Frostbolt** before, **Frostfire Bolt** after, with **Frost Nova**, a step back and **Ice Lance** into the freeze throughout. Frost points come first (**Ice Lance** at 20, **Shatter** by 27, **Fingers of Frost** at 30-31), then **Accelerant** (35-39) and the Fire points that make the bolt hit harder: **Ignite**, **Burning Soul**, **Incineration**, **Master of Elements**, **Critical Mass** and one point of **Impact** at 60. In the open leveling search's 20-60 race of 2026-11-06 it took about 36 seconds per kill level-weighted, behind the Frost page's 30.5; the page's numbers table has each level.
why: **Frostfire Bolt** (trained at level 40) counts as Frost and Fire, so both trees' talents apply (**Ice Shards**, **Frost Channeling**, **Ignite**, **Critical Mass**, **Master of Elements**), and it slows like **Frostbolt** (40%), so its chill rolls **Frostbite** (15% to freeze) and **Fingers of Frost** (15%: your next 2 spells count as cast on a frozen target). **Accelerant** cuts its 3-second cast to 2.5. The tuned rules (2026-11-06) cast it only while the mob has more than about a third (35%) of its health.
Before level 40 **Frostbolt** does the same job, to the end of the fight (the rules veto only **Frostfire Bolt**); finish with an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand.

**Ice Lance** and **Shatter** are the build's two most valuable talents in the open search (about 10.3 and 7.6 seconds per kill at 60, then **Ice Shards** 3.7, **Fingers of Frost** 3.3, **Frostbite** 2.2 and **Frost Channeling** 2.1): a frozen mob takes 300% more damage from **Ice Lance**, with 50% more crit chance and **Ice Shards**' bigger crits. It has an 8-second cooldown, one per freeze.
**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you, then step back out of melee. **Improved Frost Nova** (32, 55) brings it back 4 seconds sooner with both points.
No **Fire Blast** and no **Cone of Cold**: the tuned rules switch both off for this list (kills measured faster without), so the finish is an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand.

**Master of Elements** refunds 30% of a spell's base cost on each Fire or Frost crit, which **Shatter** makes common; **Critical Mass** adds 6% crit to your Fire spells, **Frostfire Bolt** included, and **Incineration** adds crit to **Ice Lance**.
caveats: **Burning Soul** keeps hits from pushing a Fire cast back (70% at 3 points). The leveling filler pass of 2026-11-09 moved five points that measured nothing or only held a tier open (Blast Wave, Fire Power, Arcane Resilience and both Frost Warding) to **Improved Frostbolt**, **Improved Frost Nova** and **Impact**: 2/25/24, with no Blast Wave for packs.

The signature rule: the Frostfire spec must do at least 30% of its damage with **Frostfire Bolt** from level 40. The page shows the build at 37% at level 60 in the fight lab; the rules that keep it there cost a little speed against a plain Frost list.

Mana: **Frostfire Bolt** costs 370 at top rank. Drink below 15% of your mana and eat below 40% of your health (the tuned rules); use **Evocation** between fights when it is ready and you are under 40% mana.
diverge: On a nearly dead mob (below about a third of its health), start no bolt: an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand.
Mob on you with **Frost Nova** down: keep casting the bolt (**Burning Soul** keeps most hits from pushing it back); with a pack, **Cone of Cold** is back in play.
